learning.source: eleven recent automation task statuses, automation memory ownership stops, and missing-instance audit
learning.decision_impact: Paused the loose cron and proposed a reversible single-controller lease experiment before any recurring schedule can resume
learning.author: sol-controller

applied_adaptations.failure_pattern: Loose cron fan-out created separate tasks without a project lease; eleven recent tasks included two system errors and repeated ownership collisions
applied_adaptations.hypothesis: One project instance with a fenced primary work lease and cycle scorecard will eliminate overlapping ownership and make cost per accepted capability measurable
applied_adaptations.experiment: Pause the loose cron, bind the current program and scorecard to the project instance, and forward-test one manually initiated governed cycle before any schedule is re-enabled
applied_adaptations.success_metric: Zero overlapping leases, zero system-error wakes, exactly one primary capability, and a complete cost latency token movement reviewer receipt
applied_adaptations.rollback: Cancel the instance, keep the cron paused, preserve evidence, and return to explicitly user-directed bounded tasks

archived_evidence.reason: Install the project-scoped program contract after the loose cron produced overlapping tasks, system errors, and unmeasured cost
